decisions.reason: The button resistor pull-up and active-LOW decision does not change the independent charge-status LED interface; shared 3.3V and connector terminology is incidental.
The source changes only panel-button input biasing; it does not alter the MT3608 enable pull-down, GPIO-controlled 5V rail, or powered loads.
The SPS30 connector, I2C signals, SEL-to-GND connection, and logic-level compatibility remain unchanged by the panel-button pull-up decision.
